# BAD-028 — web/CLAUDE.md is published to my.badtakes.io and is live today

## Brief
scripts/build-web.js's copyTree SKIP set holds README.md but not CLAUDE.md, so the 25KB internal agent doc for web/ is copied into dist/web and deployed by deploy-web.yml. It is serving right now. The file names internal architecture, the render service, bucket and workflow names, and the private repo's conventions - which the private-repo-no-public-links rule exists to keep off user-facing surfaces. The fix is one entry in SKIP plus an assertion beside test/build-web.test.js's existing README.md one; it also stops the file riding into mobile/www and the iOS bundle. Out of my brief: scripts/build-web.js is not a BAD-015 deliverable and the spec's section 7 lists it as unchanged.

Evidence: npm run web:build on this tree produced dist/web/CLAUDE.md (25650 bytes) beside robots.txt; scripts/build-web.js:67 reads const SKIP = new Set(['README.md', 'scenes']); and copyTree skips only those and dotfiles. curl -sS -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code} %{content_type}' -r 0-200 https://my.badtakes.io/CLAUDE.md -> '206 text/markdown; charset=utf-8'. test/build-web.test.js:64 already asserts !exists(dist/web/README.md), so the rule is established and CLAUDE.md is simply missing from it.
